DAY 1 ⏱️ ~65 mins

Day 1 — Upper Push

Upper Chest Shelf, 3D Shoulders & Horseshoe Triceps

Focus: Upper chest clavicular shelf, lateral deltoid capping, and heavy triceps lockout.
Move #1 • Motion Loop
▶ Watch Form Video (FIT.nl)
#1

Seated Incline Chest Machine

Upper Chest (Clavicular Head Shelf)
3 Sets × 8–10 Reps 90s Rest Double Progression ▶ Video Tutorial (FIT.nl) ↗
🎯 Target Muscle & Activation
Loads the upper clavicular fibers of the pectoralis major directly beneath the collarbones to create a dense, elevated upper chest shelf.
📐 Setup, Stance & Grip
Adjust seat height so the machine handles align level with your upper chest / clavicle. Plant feet flat with heels driven into floor.
💡 Form Cues & Execution
Pinch shoulder blades against back pad. Press diagonally upward and forward, driving biceps toward collarbones. Squeeze for 1s at top without rolling shoulders.
🎥 Verified Tutorial Video & Biomechanics
▶ PLAY TUTORIAL Incline Machine Chest Press | Proper Form Tutorial for Upper Chest by FIT.nl ↗
⚠️ Common Mistakes to Avoid
Setting seat too low (turns into a shoulder press) or flaring elbows at 90° (impinges rotator cuffs). Keep elbows tucked at 45°–60°.
📈 Next Session Progression Target
When you hit 10, 10, 10 reps with zero shoulder compensation, increase machine weight by +2.5 kg next week.

▶ Watch Form Video (Jeff Nippard)
#2

Flat Barbell Bench Press

Mid & Lower Chest (Sternal Pec Mass)
3 Sets × 8–10 Reps 2 mins Rest Double Progression ▶ Video Tutorial (Jeff Nippard) ↗
🎯 Target Muscle & Activation
Primary compound builder for thick sternal chest density and overall horizontal pushing power.
📐 Setup, Stance & Grip
Lie on bench with eyes directly under the bar. Retract shoulder blades, slight arch in lower back, feet planted firmly for leg drive. Grip slightly wider than shoulders.
💡 Form Cues & Execution
Unrack bar and pull shoulders down into back pockets. Lower bar under control to lower sternum/nipple line with forearms vertical. Press up explosively in slight arc.

▶ PLAY TUTORIAL How To Get A Huge Bench Press with Perfect Technique by Jeff Nippard ↗
⚠️ Common Mistakes to Avoid
Bouncing bar off chest, flaring elbows perpendicular to torso, or lifting glutes off bench. Keep heels grounded and descent controlled.
📈 Next Session Progression Target
Hit 10, 10, 10 reps -> add +1.25 kg to +2.5 kg next week. If lower reps (8, 7, 6), stay at this weight and aim for +1 rep.

Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise

Side Shoulders (Lateral Deltoid Width & V-Taper)
4 Sets × 12–15 Reps 60s Rest Double Progression ▶ Video Tutorial (Renaissance Periodization) ↗
🎯 Target Muscle & Activation
Isolates the lateral deltoid to widen shoulder span, instantly exaggerating the V-taper down to a narrow waist.
📐 Setup, Stance & Grip
Sit on edge of a flat bench with chest tilted forward ~15°. Seated position completely eliminates hip swinging and leg cheating.
💡 Form Cues & Execution
Raise dumbbells outward in the scapular plane (30° forward from torso line). Lead with elbows and keep pinkies slightly elevated. 2s slow descent.

📈 Next Session Progression Target
Stay at current weight until hitting 15, 15, 15, 15 clean reps, then increase dumbbell weight by +1 kg per hand.

#1

Smith Machine Squat (Feet 4" Forward)

Quads (Pure Knee Extension - Zero Back Shear)
3 Sets × 6–8 Reps 2 mins Rest Double Progression ▶ Video Tutorial (Scott Herman Fitness) ↗
🎯 Target Muscle & Activation
Forces complete quad isolation. Eliminates lumbar spinal shear and anterior pelvic tilt compression by leaning back into the guided bar path.
📐 Setup, Stance & Grip
Rest bar across upper traps. Place feet 4 inches FORWARD from bar line, shoulder-width apart, toes turned 15° out.
💡 Form Cues & Execution
Keep torso completely vertical. Sit down by flexing knees until thighs hit parallel to floor. Drive through midfoot and heels to stand.

⚠️ Common Mistakes to Avoid
Placing feet directly under the bar (forces hip hinge and lower back strain). Feet MUST be 4 inches forward for pure quad drive!
📈 Next Session Progression Target
Hit 8, 8, 8 reps -> increase barbell weight by +2.5 kg next week.

Barbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)

Stand tall holding barbell with shoulder-width overhand grip. Feet hip-width apart, knees unlocked in soft micro-bend.

Initiate by pushing hips directly backward toward wall behind you. Shave bar down shins until mid-shin and hamstrings are at maximum stretch. Drive hips forward through heels.

The 8 Non-Negotiable Daily Staples

1. Whole Eggs Only Up to 5 / day
Never separate egg whites. Provides bioavailable protein, choline, lutein, and healthy cholesterol for testosterone.
2. Toned Milk Up to 500ml / day
Split between morning oats and evening tea/coffee. Rich in casein and calcium for bone density.
3. Pottukadalai (Roasted Chana) 50g / day
Afternoon 4:30 PM crunch providing ~11g plant protein and 5g gut fiber without cooking effort.
4. Peanuts & Cashews 15g + 15g daily
15g roasted peanuts + 15g raw cashews. Delivers zinc, magnesium, and essential monounsaturated fats.
5. Pure Honey 1–2 tsp (15g)
Natural morning sweetener for oats or pre-gym fast glucose to top off liver glycogen.
6. Rolled / Instant Oats 50g daily
Low-glycemic complex carbohydrates and beta-glucan fiber to sustain morning mental and physical energy.
7. Soya Chunks Cap 45g dry-weighed
Delivers ~23.4g protein on non-chicken days. Must be weighed raw on a digital scale before boiling.
8. Chicken Gravy (Wed & Sun) Home-Cooked
Fresh morning batch spread across breakfast, lunch, and dinner. No whey isolate powder needed on these days!

Dynamic Nutrition Rebalancing Protocols

Scenario 1: Missed / Skipped Meal

Do not skip protein. Roll the missed protein into evening or dinner: add 2 whole boiled eggs, extra 150ml milk, or 100g curd. Always protect the 145g protein floor!

Scenario 2: Heavy / Unplanned Meal

Do not starve. For remaining meals: drop 1 chapati, skip peanuts, remove cooking oil, and take pure protein (boiled eggs or whey in water). Add a 20-min evening stroll (+2,500 steps).

🧘 Daily 5-Minute Morning Posture & APT Reset Protocol

Perform every morning immediately after using the washroom and drinking 500ml room-temperature water.

1. Stomach Vacuums (Transverse Abdominis Tucking) ▶ Mind Pump TV Tutorial ↗
4 sets × 20-second isometric holds. Exhale all air completely, pull belly button back toward spine as hard as possible, and hold breath/vacuum. Trains the inner anatomical corset to suck in lower abdominal protrusion.
2. Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch with Posterior Pelvic Tilt ▶ The Prehab Guys Tutorial ↗
2 sets × 45–60s per leg. Kneel on one knee, squeeze the rear glute hard to tuck pelvis backward, and shift forward slightly until front hip flexor (psoas) stretches. Reverses hours of IT desk chair sitting.
3. Glute Squeezes & Pelvic Tucks ▶ Athlean-X APT Fix Guide ↗
2 sets × 10 reps (3-second squeeze at top). Lie on back or stand tall. Squeeze gluteus maximus to tuck tailbone under, waking up glute motor units before sitting at desk.
